tagline: Surf lessons in Weligama, on the south coast of Sri Lanka.
closing: Send us the lesson and date you want on WhatsApp, or call the same number.
featureLine: Making waves, one lesson at a time.

copyBlocks.heading: Who we teach
copyBlocks.body:
You can come to us as a total beginner, a beginner who can already stand up, an intermediate or an advanced surfer.

Lessons are in English as standard.

copyBlocks.heading: Sanjee, head instructor
copyBlocks.body:
I was born in Weligama and learned to surf on a broken board my uncle fixed with resin and hope.

Today I teach surfers from all over the world — and I still paddle out every single morning.

copyBlocks.heading: Lessons
copyBlocks.body:
Every lesson includes professional instruction and a beach safety briefing. Board and rash guard rental is in the price too.

The Week Intensive is spread across 10 days, so you can pick your best days. After 2 hours of surfing, your muscles will be happily exhausted. Get in touch beforehand and we'll work out which days and times suit you.

For group bookings, please leave us a message.

copyBlocks.heading: Board rental
copyBlocks.body:
Our shop sits 30 seconds from the sand at Coco Beach, Weligama. Free dry storage there while you eat or rest between sessions.

We rent soft-top foamies 8'0–9'0, mini-mals 7'2–7'10, mid-lengths and funboards 6'8–7'4, fish and hybrids 5'8–6'4, performance shortboards 5'10–6'2 and longboards 9'0–9'4.

Each board comes with a leash sized for it (6 ft – 9 ft) and fins fitted to your style (FCS-II or Futures). You also get wax for tropical water and a fresh wax comb.

To rent a board we need an ID or passport copy and a refundable deposit. Ask us how much it is.

copyBlocks.heading: By tuk-tuk
copyBlocks.body:
The Surf Spot Safari and the Full Coast Adventure go looking for waves, and so does the Sunrise Session.

The other nine are outings along the coast and inland, at estimated introductory prices, with pickup and return within Weligama.

Each tour price covers up to 2 people.

copyBlocks.heading: Before you book
copyBlocks.body:
You need to be able to swim at least 50 meters unaided.

We teach kids from age 6 and up. Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

Cash on the day can be LKR, USD or EUR. All prices are as of 5 November 2026.

copyBlocks.heading: Other waves, as we rate them
copyBlocks.body:
Jungle Beach and Weligama Main Point are both beach breaks we'd call beginner waves. Mirissa, also a beach break, goes from beginner to intermediate.

For intermediates there's Fishermans (a reef break), Island Point (a point break), Plantation Point (a right-hand reef) and Lazy Left in Midigama, a long left-hand reef. Lazy Right, also in Midigama, is a right-hand reef that goes from intermediate to advanced.

Ram's Right, a reef break, and Kabalana (The Rock), an A-frame reef, are for advanced surfers.

copyBlocks.heading: Finding us
copyBlocks.body: On Google Maps, look for Sanjee Surf School (plus code XC63+4H). You may also see us as Sanjee Surf.

spot: Coco Beach is our home spot, a beach break. Smaller crowds than the main peak and a friendly, mellow vibe, ideal for first pop-ups.
season: Best surf season runs November to April; peak swell and dry weather are December–February.

lessons.label: Beginner Lesson
lessons.includes: Safety basics and ocean awareness, board handling, paddle and pop-up practice, catching your first waves

priceList.label: Surf Spot Safari (half day, 4 hours)
priceList.note: 5+ potential surf spots around Weligama Bay, chosen for your skill level. Flexible timing, photo stops.

priceList.label: Full Coast Adventure (full day, 8 hours)
priceList.note: 10+ potential surf spots, some of them local breaks. Sri Lankan lunch included.

priceList.label: Sunrise Session (3 hours)
priceList.note: 3 spots at dawn, with a 5:30 AM pickup and a breakfast stop.

priceList.label: Weligama Bay & Taprobane Island (approx. 2 hours)
priceList.note: Bay viewpoints and photo stops, with the island seen from the shore. Island entry, meals and activities not included.

priceList.label: Midigama Reef Breaks (approx. 3 hours)
priceList.note: Lazy Left and Lazy Right viewpoints and beach stops. Not beginner lesson spots. Boards, lessons and meals not included.

priceList.label: Mirissa Beach & Coconut Tree Hill (approx. 4 hours)
priceList.note: Beach time and the viewpoint. No whale-watching boat trip. Entry fees, meals and activities not included.

priceList.label: Ahangama & Kabalana (approx. 4 hours)
priceList.note: Coastal stops, Kabalana Beach and a view of the Rock reef break. Boards, lessons and meals not included.

priceList.label: Secret Beach Mirissa (approx. 4 hours)
priceList.note: Final access may need a walk. Swimming depends on the sea and is not guaranteed safe. Entry fees and meals not included.

priceList.label: Turtle Bay & Snake Farm (approx. 4 hours)
priceList.note: Coastal stops; snake farm optional, admission paid separately. Wildlife not guaranteed. Snorkeling and meals not included.

priceList.label: Handunugoda Tea Estate (approx. 4 hours)
priceList.note: Inland through the countryside. Estate admission, tastings and meals not included.

priceList.label: Galle Fort (approx. 6 hours)
priceList.note: Time on foot on the ramparts and historic streets. Museum entry and meals not included.

priceList.label: Hiriketiya Bay (approx. 8 hours)
priceList.note: Beach time and coastal stops. Surfing depends on conditions and ability; boards, lessons and meals not included.

priceList.label: Reef booties, to buy, per pair

testimonials.quote: I would definitely recommend going out with Sanjee. I spent two mornings surfing with him and it was amazing. He made sure I was always in the best positions to catch the wave on the local break, meaning I was catching far more waves than if i was on my own. He is very friendly and a joy to surf with.
testimonials.author: hal starkie

testimonials.quote: Sanjee is an outstanding surf coach. After just 7 intensive training days, he gave me the confidence to surf bigger waves and significantly improve my level. His teaching is clear, professional, and very motivating. I highly recommend him to anyone who wants to progress safely and effectively.”
testimonials.author: Rossana Encina

testimonials.quote: Sanjee is one the best coaches there is to learn surfing.  He was very patient. And supportive.  I was able to catch waves and stand on my board till close to the shore in the first session itself. Id definitely recommend him and would come again to learn from him for intermediate and advanced course as well.
testimonials.author: samagra singh

testimonials.quote: Great guy. Better then most other surf instructors i met before. Very calm and patient. Highly recommend.
testimonials.author: Tim St
